$comment: Declared body markers for every liveUrl in content/products.ts.
Read by scripts/check-live-link-markers.mjs. Declarations, not inferences:
CHECKS.md's rule is 'prefer declared links to inferred ones', and a marker
guessed from a URL's shape would re-create the failure this check exists to
catch. Every marker below was copied from that URL's actual response body on
Pick markers that are specific to the page's IDENTITY and stable across
routine updates. A version string is a bad marker (it churns); a product name
or a framework's own UI signature is a good one.

links.why: Product name in <title>. Present whenever the app shell renders.
Tagline in <title>. Distinguishes the real game from a Vercel error page.
Space slug. An HF 404 renders a generic shell without it.
Bridge-page heading. Confirms the warmup route, not a Next.js 404.
Repo path in <title>. Deliberately NOT the version — /latest moves, and pinning v1.3.0 would fail on the next release for no real reason.

FastAPI's Swagger page signature, copied from this URL's actual 2026-08-15 response body (200), not carried over from the old entry. The citation was fixed in PR #93 (content/products.ts now points here instead of the decommissioned review-iq-prod Cloud Run URL, which 503s) — this entry follows that fix rather than tracking it as separately outstanding.
Page heading. A GitHub Pages 404 does not contain it.
